supported_stopping_assumption: The greedy sequence induction requires that stopping decisions agree at each common prefix. This follows for identical stopping rules depending only on shared token identities, common prefix state and length. A stopping rule depending on model scores requires a separately verified stability bound; using the same score-threshold policy is not enough.
supported_mask_assumption: The feasible token mask must also agree at each shared prefix. Identical source code for a score-dependent mask does not by itself prove identical decisions.
logical_direction: Argmax agreement does not alone establish stopping, adaptive-mask or output-format agreement. All auxiliary decision conditions remain explicit sufficient assumptions.
